gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-asta-sans: A horseshoe-wide c and diagonals as heavy as the verticals give Cherry Swash its loud, unmistakable face, while Asta Sans stays a plain sans of tubelike lines. One shouts, the other nods along.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bai-jamjuree: Big personality, then quiet. Cherry Swash is built for making an entrance with its wide-open c, while Bai Jamjuree is a sans-serif that does its best work in light, round, unmodulated letters.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-barlow: Barlow has c shapes with tips pulled well apart and strokes like neon tubing, giving the sans a contemporary, approachable ease. And Cherry Swash is where the swagger lives, its heavy diagonals doing the commanding.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-biz-udgothic: Cherry Swash arrives with a horseshoe c and heavy diagonals. BIZ UDGothic follows in a sans-serif with a wide channel into every bowl, so the loud heading hands off to a modern, businesslike text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-biz-udpgothic: That horseshoe-wide c and the heavy diagonals make Cherry Swash feel distinctive from the first word, with BIZ UDPGothic below it. Its lavish spacing keeps a plain sans easy going.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bpmf-huninn: Cherry Swash opens with a horseshoe c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, a commanding, distinctive display face for the top. Bpmf Huninn sits beneath it, outline-like and modern.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Cherry Swash bends its lines like straw. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std then settles in, its counters staying connected to the outside and its curves swelling gently, so paragraphs of the sans feel comfortable.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-cairo: Cherry Swash has no thick-thin modulation at all, just a wide horseshoe c and weighty diagonals that give it presence. But Cairo, a modern sans-serif with a wide channel into every bowl, is the one built for carrying the text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-cambay: Commanding is how Cherry Swash feels, with its smooth tube-like lines and wide horseshoe c, set against Cambay, whose rounds gap like a cracked bangle. The plain sans reads modern and light.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-cantarell: A horseshoe-shaped c and diagonals as heavy as the verticals make Cherry Swash instantly recognizable, while Cantarell backs it with open-tipped c shapes. Its best quality is a sturdy, approachable arch.
